title: The Kunlun road stretches endlessly
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji stepped onto the hidden path, the Tianji Record shuddered violently—the aura of fate atop the mountain was identical to that of the Demonic Path Commander from Chapter 777.

text.content:
Morning mist hung like silk around Chen Ji's ankles. Standing at the outer edge of the Kunlun range, he gazed at the main peak shrouded in black miasma, yet his heart remained as still as an ancient well.

The legend of fate's twins—unification or mutual destruction. The answer to this choice, he had yet to comprehend. The only certainty was Chen Nian's location, somewhere within those mists.

"A Nian..." he silently called the name in his heart, his knuckles tightening slightly. "Brother is coming for you."

With that, he took his first step, entering the forbidden land forever cloaked in demonic energy.

The moment he entered the outer mountains, Chen Ji sensed an abrupt shift in the atmosphere.

A faint scent of sulfur and decay mingled in the air—the mark left by Demonic Path cultivation arts. An ordinary cultivator venturing here would likely have their very meridians corroded by such foulness.

But Chen Ji was different. The True Qi from the Tianji Record Fragment flowing through his veins was connected to the laws of the Heavenly Dao, granting him natural resistance to such demonic energy.

"Demonic Path vanguard... it seems the Holy Sect's reach has extended even here." He narrowed his eyes, gazing toward a watchtower constructed from black stones nearby.

As expected, someone was there.

Chen Ji slowed his pace, suppressing his aura to near nothingness.

He understood clearly that the Kunlun range was the sole passage to the mountain summit. And since the Demonic Path forces had positioned themselves here, they would inevitably have layered checkpoints. If he charged in recklessly, even if he could fight his way through, he would expose his presence and alert the enemy.

But time was not on his side. Every moment of delay increased the danger to Chen Nian.

The Tianji Record within his Mental Sea pulsed with gentle warmth, as if urging him to make a decision.

"Hehe, young friend ahead, since you've come, why not reveal yourself and chat?"

A sinister voice drifted from the watchtower. Chen Ji's brow slightly creased as he looked up to see a shadow descend from the tower's peak, landing steadily ten zhang away.

The newcomer wore black combat attire, a curved blade hung at his waist, demonic energy coiled around his form—his cultivation at Foundation Building Seventh Stage. Behind him stood three Demonic Path cultivators with somewhat weaker auras.

"A little servant from Tianqing Sect?" The leader licked his lips, greed flickering in his eyes. "Your skin is quite delicate—wonder if your inner elixir tastes equally exquisite."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's steps never faltered, his gaze sweeping over the group with casual indifference. That gaze was calm to the point of coldness, as if observing a swarm of bothersome ants.

"Those who block my path—die."

Three words, delivered lightly, yet they froze the smiles on every Demonic Path cultivator present.

text.content:
"Ha! Ha ha ha!" The leading demon cultivator doubled over with laughter. "A Foundation Building Seventh Stage wretch dares speak such nonsense to us!"

He abruptly drew his curved blade, demonic energy surging forth and condensing into a ferocious black tiger phantom in the air.

"Kid, remember your grandfather's name—Tiger Specter Li Kun, thirty-seventh among the Seventy-Two Riders of the Demonic Path!"

With that, the black tiger phantom howled toward Chen Ji, bringing with it a gust of blood and slaughter.

Chen Ji watched the incoming black tiger with quietude, a hint of subtle mockery flickering in his eyes.

Foundation Building Seventh Stage? Wretch?

If these people knew what kind of existence he had just vanquished at the Sect Competition, they would probably flee in terror on the spot. Unfortunately, they wouldn't get that chance.

He didn't dodge, didn't even raise a hand.

Only when the black tiger was about to touch him did he softly utter a single word:

"Roll."

The word fell, and a clear chime suddenly rang through the air.

True Qi surged around Chen Ji as an invisible wave exploded outward from his center. That majestic black tiger phantom, the moment it touched him, shattered like thin ice meeting boiling water, piece by piece!

Li Kun's pupils constricted sharply. Before he could react, he felt a sharp pain in his chest. Looking down, he saw an elegant palm had pierced through his torso, blood dripping between the fingers.

"You... how could you..."

Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged as he withdrew his right hand, letting the corpse collapse limply to the ground. He didn't even glance at it more than once, as if he had merely crushed an annoying insect.

choice.prompt: The remaining three demon cultivators turned ashen-faced, their will to fight utterly shattered. They were about to flee. What should Chen Ji do?

choices.text: Cut the grass and eliminate the roots

text.content:
Chen Ji's wrist flicked, and three sword-qi whistled through the air.

The three demon cultivators didn't even have time to scream before they were decapitated. Blood dyed the snow beneath their feet, blooming into three striking crimson plum blossoms.

"Noisy." He shook the blood from his fingertips, his gaze remaining cold.

choices.description: Killing them would be wasteful—better to extract intelligence about the forward defenses from their mouths.
choices.visible_cost: Requires divided attention to guard them
choices.visible_reward: Gain intelligence about the forward defenses

text.content:
Chen Ji raised his hand, True Qi transforming into chains that bound one of them into a helpless bundle.

"P-Please don't kill me!" The demon cultivator trembled violently.

Chen Ji crouched down, his voice平静得可怕："前方有几道关卡？"

"Three, three of them! And there's a Holy Sect Protector stationed at the summit!"

"That will do." He stood up, slapping the man unconscious with a palm, then walked forward without looking back.

text.content:
Chen Ji swept a cold glance at the remaining three, then withdrew his oppressive aura.

"Get out of my sight and tell your people—Chen Ji of the Tianqing Sect has arrived. If you want to intercept me, come ahead."

The three scrambled away like drowning rats, fleeing into the depths of the forest.

Chen Ji watched their retreating figures, a slight smile curling his lips. He wanted these people to become the perfect bait.

Chen Ji continued his ascent toward the mid-mountain.

As the altitude increased, so did the density of demonic energy. An ordinary cultivator would find each step as heavy as carrying a thousand jun's in such an environment. But Chen Ji, protected by the Tianji Record Fragment, moved through it all with leisurely ease.

Along the way, he encountered two more hidden sentries, both eliminated by his swift and decisive methods. Unconsciously, his robes had become stained with patches of blood.

"One final barrier remains..." He raised his gaze toward the dark encampment barely visible on the mid-slope, his eyes flickering.

At that moment, the Tianji Record within his Mental Sea shuddered violently.

Chen Ji's steps came to an abrupt halt, his brow furrowed. He had never felt such an intense reaction from the Tianji Record—and within that tremor, there seemed to be a hint of... urgency?

The next instant, the floating fragment within his Mental Sea unfolded of its own accord, and amidst the flowing golden light, a vision materialized before him:

A hidden mountain path, descending from a sheer cliff thirty zhang behind the encampment, leading directly to the summit!

"This is..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, "Could this be a resonance with the complete Tianji Record?"

dialogue.content:
"Well, well, lad, you've finally discovered it."

An elderly voice resonated within his Mental Sea. A subtle shift crossed Chen Ji's features—it was the fragmented soul's guardian, Mo Xiansheng.

"The Kunlun Summit is an ancient forbidden land, with its own hidden arrangements made by both the righteous and demonic factions. But do you know, this concealed path is actually the escape route left behind by the original owner of the Tianji Record."

"The original owner of the Tianji Record..." Chen Ji's heart trembled.

"Indeed. Back then, he too once stood where you now stand. And this path will help you evade all obvious dangers—including that thread of destiny's aura waiting for you at the summit."

text.content:
Chen Ji drew a deep breath, suppressing the tumultuous emotions within him.

That aura of destiny.

It was identical to what he had sensed from the Demonic Path commander in chapter seven hundred seventy-seven.

What did this signify? Why would the commander of the Holy Sect appear at the Kunlun summit? Could his true objective extend beyond merely searching for Chen Nian?

The Tianji Record pulsed again, as if urging him to make a choice.

"I understand." Chen Ji murmured, stealthily moving toward the encampment's flank, "Since it's a layout by the original owner, it should be trustworthy."

Thirty zhang away, the sheer cliff appeared as if carved by divine axes—no ordinary person could detect any trace of passage. Yet when Chen Ji's true qi from the Tianji Record flowed through this area, his vision suddenly illuminated—

A narrow crevice, just wide enough for a single person to squeeze through sideways, quietly revealed itself.

The fissure stretched into an unseen abyss, yet a refreshing breeze wafted from within, distinctly different from the murky demonic energy outside.

Without hesitation, Chen Ji squeezed sideways into the crevice.

The mountain path wound upward, and with each step, the Tianji Record glowed brighter. It was as if this path had been designed specifically for it.

After an unknown duration, the passage suddenly opened up.

The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the mountain path, a majestic altar came into view. At its four corners burned ethereal blue flames, and in its center stood a massive stone gate—covered in ancient runes that bore a striking resemblance to the patterns on the Tianji Record.

But what drew Chen Ji's attention even more was the figure standing before the gate.

Black robes billowing, silver hair like snow.

The figure had its back turned to him, yet it made every hair on Chen Ji's body stand on end.

A familiar pressure, deeply ingrained in his very bones, crashed over him like a tidal wave.

"So, you've arrived."

The figure slowly turned around, revealing a handsome yet utterly bloodless face.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

That face—he had seen it in the prophetic vision of chapter seven hundred seventy-seven. The Demonic Path commander—or more precisely, the true mastermind lurking behind the Holy Sect.

"Chen Ji's fate is indeed closely intertwined with the Tianji Record." A faint smile played on the figure's lips, his voice as clear and cold as a mountain spring, "I've been waiting for you for a very long time, successor of the Tianji Record."

Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but beneath the surface, turbulent waves churned in his heart.

Did he know his identity?

Did he know about the Tianji Record?

Who... who was this person?

"Who are you?" Chen Ji asked in a deep voice.

The figure stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze falling upon Chen Ji's chest—where the Tianji Record emanated a faint golden glow.

"Who I am is not important. What matters is..." He paused, a meaningful smile curving his lips, "Your sister, Chen Nian, is right behind this gate."

Chen Ji's fingers whitened.

A-Nian!

"What do you want?" He forced himself to remain calm, yet his voice had already taken on a slight tremor.

The figure smiled without answering, merely stepping aside to reveal the full view of the ancient stone gate behind him.

"Come in, Chen Ji. Your shared fate awaits you to unveil with your own hands."

Chen Ji stood motionless, the Tianji Record within his Mental Sea quivering violently, as if warning him of something.

Yet his gaze swept past the mysterious man, fixing upon that stone gate covered in ancient runes.

Behind the gate was Chen Nian.

His sister, whom he had been searching for across countless chapters.

His only remaining kin in this world.

"..." Chen Ji closed his eyes, drew a deep breath, and upon opening them again, his gaze had returned to perfect tranquility.

Be it dragon's pool or tiger's den.

Since A-Nian was inside, retreat was never an option.

"Show me the way." He stepped forward, his voice cold and unwavering as always, "But I suggest you pray that you haven't deceived me."

The mysterious figure chuckled softly, turned around, and pushed open the stone gate.

Beyond the gate, brilliant golden light blazed.

Chen Ji stepped inside.

And the gears of destiny began to turn once more.
